candidates.sentence: She knows her children and grandchildren will be responsible for the reckless spending of the current Administration.

Jen will continue to lead the fight for election reforms in Congress by fighting to stop voting irregularities, maintain a photo ID requirement, prevent ballot harvesting, and ensure all state election officials — not just in battleground states — can keep our process secure and transparent.
Jen is a staunch defender of the Second Amendment who never compromises our right to bear arms.

A secure border is a more secure Virginia and a more secure America.
She remains committed to holding the Biden Administration and Democrats in Washington accountable for their failures to deter global threats like China, Russia, and Iran.
In Congress, Jen is a fierce advocate for seniors and fights to protect and preserve Medicare and Social Security.
She opposes Medicare for All, which would ruin seniors’ healthcare.

While extreme politicians have overly politicized this issue, she believes abortion laws should be determined at the state level, but is firmly opposed to radical state policies which would allow abortions up to the moment of birth.

In Congress, Jen stands up for our Second Amendment rights and supports policies that make it easier for law-abiding Virginians to protect themselves and their families while getting guns out of the hands of criminals.
